kat: Heads-up  we had a brief EU inference regression overnight. Need a single authoritative status message, email cadence, and where inbound leads/demo requests land. Drafting below.

kat: DRAFT status (short):

We experienced a partial degradation of inference services in the EU region between 02:11 and 02:39 UTC. A recent networking configuration change caused degraded routing to a subset of GPU pools; the change was reverted and services returned to normal at 02:39 UTC. Traffic and health checks are verified across EU clusters. No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident.

We will publish a post-incident report within 72 hours detailing root cause and mitigations.

nina: Good. Suggest swapping "degradation" -> "intermittent failures" for clarity. Add subject suggestion for Dedicated: "Service update: EU region (resolved 02:39 UTC)  impact & next steps".

pranav: Ops says all checks green. Incident tag: "incident-eu-2026-11" please add to subject and internal headers so support can auto-filter.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-111: EU inference degradation  resolved at 1771001199 (02:39 UTC). Postmortem owner: @eng-runtime.

alex: Routing: Dedicated & Private get detailed email now (within 30-60m) with SEs CC'd and proactive calls to any account with >5% EU traffic. Hosted customers get a concise banner + short email in 3h. Sales-ops: any demo/trial requests from affected customers -> sales-ops-incident channel; do not push to general SDR queue.

support-bot: Support estimate: expect 12-30 tickets. We'll tag tickets with "incident-eu-2026-11" and prioritize any renewal/ops-impact flags.

A post-incident report will be published within 72 hours with timeline and mitigations. If you need immediate assistance, contact support@redwood.ai or your assigned SE.

pranav: Approve. Please include the verification line exactly as: "Traffic and automated health checks are verified across EU clusters." Ops confirms.

nina: Timing plan: 1) Publish short RESOLVED status page entry now; 2) Send detailed email to Dedicated & Private in 45m with incident tag and SE call list; 3) Hosted banner + short hosted email in 3 hours linking to status; 4) Postmortem blog 48-72h.

alex: Sales-ops will triage inbound leads. We'll route demos and renewal signals to account teams and flag high-risk renewals. Sales-ops-bot will post daily counts.
